## AccrualVaultV2.accrueInterest() method

Returns a new vault derived from this vault, whose interest has been accrued up to the given timestamp. Performance and management fee shares are zero when the corresponding fee recipient cannot receive vault shares.

**Signature:**

```typescript
accrueInterest(timestamp: BigIntish): {
        vault: AccrualVaultV2;
        performanceFeeShares: bigint;
        managementFeeShares: bigint;
    };
```
